a.lede: Unlike narrated audiobooks from Audible and other providers, the audiobooks created with Virtual Voice in Kindle+ will instead be narrated by AI.
a.title: Amazon’s Kindle Unlimited is now Kindle+, and the 2 big changes include AI audiobooks

b.lede: The service still offers a library of books, magazines and comics, and now includes a larger selection of audiobooks.
b.title: Amazon rebrands Kindle Unlimited to Kindle+
